Title: Manage payment methods in the Azure portal

Body.Content:
Web-direct customers in the United States can now update, add, and remove payment methods for their subscriptions in the Azure portal.

To get started:

  1. Go to Subscriptions.
  2. Select a subscription.
  3. Select Payment methods.

Let us know what you think via UserVoice.
